analysis_summary: The ontology is designed for simulating a 10,000-agent social media discourse around Portuguese educational needs, exam pressures (exames nacionais), private tutoring (explicações), and the adoption of AI study tools by Magic Book Technologies. It explicitly models voice-capable stakeholders including diverse students, parents (encarregados de educação), private tutors, certified teachers, EdTech developers, institutions, ministries, and media platforms, while concluding with fallback types Person and Organization.
